[SWS_CM_12006] Asynchronous nature of Subscribe()
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00106, RS_CM_00107
⌈
In order to keep application functionality robust against Network Binding configuration
changes, applications shall assume asynchronous operation when calling
Subscribe
.
This implies not assuming success in the subscription process until
GetSubscrip-
tionState()
or the handler set by
SetSubscriptionStateChangeHandler()
have reported
kSubscribed
, even if
Subscribe()
has returned with no error.
⌋
